name: MENU_F_KIND_MASK
meaning: kind: 0 = page/submenu (CROSS enters it), 1 = leaf item (LEFT/RIGHT/CROSS messages); 2 and 3 get no input handling

name: MENU_F_HAS_HANDLER
meaning: +4 is a MenuHandler, otherwise a char* label

name: MENU_F_DISABLED
meaning: greyed (0xA0A0A0), skipped by navigation, cannot be entered

name: MENU_F_SELECTED
meaning: set on the cursor node by Menu_Update; Menu_Printf blinks it
